Plot STABL selection diagnostics

Source: R/diagnostics.R
plot.stabl_diagnostics.Rd

Plot STABL selection diagnostics

Usage

# S3 method for class 'stabl_diagnostics'
plot(x, which = c("fdp_curve", "threshold_path", "score_distributions"), ...)

Arguments

x

A stabl_diagnostics object from stabl_diagnose().

which

Character vector of panels to draw: "fdp_curve" (FDP+ along the threshold range, with the selected cut-off and all minimizing thresholds marked), "threshold_path" (real vs artificial selection counts along the path), and "score_distributions" (survival curves, i.e. 1 - ECDF, of real and artificial per-feature maximum scores).

...

Passed to plotting helpers; currently ignored.

Value

Invisibly, a named list of the drawn ggplot objects.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  x <- matrix(rnorm(60 * 8), 60, 8,
              dimnames = list(paste0("s", 1:60), paste0("f", 1:8)))
  y <- setNames(x[, 1] * 2 + rnorm(60), rownames(x))
  fit <- stabl_fit(x, y, n_bootstraps = 20, lambda_grid = "auto",
                   artificial_type = "random_permutation")
  plot(stabl_diagnose(fit), which = "fdp_curve")
}
